markets.rules_primary: If Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez publicly endorses Connie Chan in CA-11 before Nov 3, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: An endorsement requires a clear, affirmative statement of support for the nominee's election. The statement must be public (not private communications) and specifically reference the race or be clearly in context of the race. The endorsement must come directly from the person or through their official channels. Positive comments without explicit support, policy endorsements without nominee endorsement, or conditional endorsements do not qualify. Social media endorsements count only from verified accounts, and likes or retweets alone do not constitute endorsement. Quote tweets with additional supportive commentary do count. Sarcastic statements or those immediately clarified as jokes do not qualify.
markets.subtitle: :: CA-11
markets.title: Will Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez endorse Connie Chan in CA-11 before Nov 3, 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If Adriana Lima is documented wearing a bra designated by Victoria’s Secret as the “Fantasy Bra” during Victoria's Secret Fashion Show 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The person must be photographed or video recorded with the article of clothing visibly worn on their body as intended (e.g., a jacket on the torso, not carried or draped). Valid documentation includes official event photography, live television coverage, professional photography from Source Agencies, or video footage from Source Agencies. The person must be clearly identifiable. Carrying, holding, or draping the item without properly wearing it does not qualify. Similar but not identical items do not satisfy the criterion. Documentation where the person cannot be clearly identified does not count toward resolution. Each year, Victoria’s Secret typically designates one bra as the “Fantasy Bra” for its annual Fashion Show. The bra may also be given a unique name (e.g., “Royal Fantasy Bra,” “Champagne Nights Fantasy Bra”) in press releases or media coverage. For the purposes of this market, “Fantasy Bra” refers only to a bra that Victoria’s Secret explicitly refers to as the “Fantasy Bra,” regardless of its specific title. If no bra is designated as the Fantasy Bra for that year, all outcomes resolve to “No.” If more than one Fantasy Bra is designated, each wearer will be treated as a separate valid outcome.
markets.subtitle: Adriana Lima
markets.title: Will Adriana Lima wear a bra designated by Victoria’s Secret as the “Fantasy Bra” at Victoria's Secret Fashion Show 2026?

markets.rules_primary:
If the price of XRP after issuance and through 11:59 PM ET on Dec 31, 2026 is ever above $
2.00, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: At each minute throughout the market duration, a settlement value is calculated using every minute-by-minute CF XRPUSD_RTI price for XRP. For each of these individual minute-by-minute checks, the top 20% and bottom 20% of the cumulative dataset are removed before calculating the average of the remaining values. If the trimmed mean associated with any single minute during the period is above the threshold, the market resolves to Yes. This methodology reduces the impact of extreme price spikes or drops. The measurement period runs from when the market is issued until the specified end time. If CF Benchmarks data is unavailable or incomplete at the expiration time, affected strikes resolve to No. For cryptocurrencies with multiple versions, the Exchange will specify which version or ticker is being tracked.
markets.title: Will XRP trimmed mean be above $2.00 by 11:59 PM ET on Dec 31, 2026?
